name: S2000 Pro Max Smart Watch – 7-in-3 Edition with Protection Case & TWS Earbuds | Full Touch Display, Bluetooth Calling, Fitness & Health Tracker, Multi-Sport Modes, Unisex, Compatible with Android
description:
S2000 Pro Max Smart Watch – 7-in-3 Edition with Protection Case & TWS Earbuds
General Information

Model: S2000 Pro Max – 7-in-3 Edition

Applicable Users: Unisex

Band Material: Silicone / Rubber (Comfortable & Durable)

Shape: Square

Compatibility: Android & iOS Devices

Connectivity & Smart Features

Call Function: Make & Receive Calls, Caller ID, Call Log

Smart Notifications: SMS, WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Skype, Line, WeChat

Health & Fitness Features

Heart Rate Monitoring

Blood Pressure & Blood Oxygen (SpO₂) Measurement

Sleep Monitoring

Step Counter & Calorie Tracker

Multi-Sports Modes: Walking, Running, Cycling, Climbing, Indoor Running, and More

Sedentary & Hydration Reminders

Breathing Exercises

Battery & Charging

Battery Capacity: 220–300mAh

Battery Life: 2–7 Days (depending on usage)

Charging Mode: Wireless Magnetic Charging

Charge Time: 2–3 Hours

Additional Features

Raise Wrist to Wake Screen

Music & Camera Control

Alarm, Stopwatch, Calendar, Calculator

Anti-Lost Function

Silent / Low Power Mode

Package Includes (7-in-3 Edition)

1 × S2000 Pro Max Smart Watch

7 × Interchangeable Straps

1 × Protection Case

1 × TWS Earbuds

1 × Wireless Charger

1 × User Manual

1 × Retail Box
